findings.one_line: Its finite-instance result is an elementary polynomial-graph encoding followed by cited generic CAD/QE; the note must either supply the promised ordered/pair-mass structural boundary or position this honestly as a computational corollary and compare it precisely with the closest DATE-feasibility and algebraic-compatibility literature.

The proposal's full-path augmented cross-fitted estimator with either-nuisance correctness and inference is absent; this known-propensity triangular-array approximation is a different, weaker deliverable and must not be presented as the promised empirical-usability layer.

Position the membership/separation theorem against Arkhangelsky et al.'s DATE feasibility formulation and the relevant positive factorization/real-algebraic optimization class at theorem level, rather than treating Collins alone as sufficient related-work support.
